The Petitioner has approached this Court for grant of bail in the event of arrest in FIR No.746/2023, registered at Police Station Moti Nagar for offences punishable under Sections 498A/406/354/377/34 IPC.
2.
The Petitioner and the Complainant are husband and wife.
This Court is of the opinion that one serious attempt can be made to settle the dispute amicably between the parties.
3. Accordingly, the parties are referred to the Delhi High Court Mediation and Conciliation Centre.
